newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany provides extra funds for Rwanda refugees.
newsitem.headline: Germany provides extra funds for Rwanda refugees.

text.p: Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel said on Monday Germany was releasing an extra 10 million marks for humanitarian organisations to help cope with the flood of Rwandan refugees heading home from Zaire.
Kinkel said the money would be split between the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, the International Red Cross and various German charities.
"The German government will do everything possible to support the work of national and international aid organisations," Kinkel said in a statement.

He said Germany had already contributed 550 million marks ($365 million) to help the refugees since 1994. Much of the extra funds would be spent on projects to ensure the refugees had clean drinking water, the foreign ministry said. ($1=1.5063 Mark)
